content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Shillong Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Shillong to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong) for various faculty positions in Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Grade-I, and Assistant Professor Grade-II across various academic departments and fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for IIM Shillong Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 31 October 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with a first class or equivalent in their preceding degree along with relevant teaching or research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for IIM Shillong Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Level-10 to Level-14A on the pay scale, depending on the specific post and grade level assigned to the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to IIM Shillong?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for applying to these faculty positions.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIM Shillong Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal available on the IIM Shillong website by filling out the form and submitting required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIM Shillong Faculty jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves scrutiny and shortlisting of applications followed by an academic seminar and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Do currently employed candidates need to submit applications through proper channels?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates already in service must forward the printout of their online application through proper channels or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and direct application link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to download the official notification PDF and access the online application portal in the Important Links section of this article.
